title: Your Brain Is Not Showing You Reality (Long Listen)
desc: Your brain is not showing you reality, it is building it. Twelve calm, sourced stories on how perception works: the dress that split the internet, the hole in your vision, the invisible gorilla, change blindness, the rubber hand illusion, the McGurk effect, cultural illusions, the predictive brain, taste and placebo, the stretch of time, faces in clouds, and what it all means. Every claim comes from a named study, and the doubts are left in.
plan: b01: intro; the dress; colour constancy; cones; language and colour
b02: blind spot; fovea; saccades; chronostasis
b03: inattentional blindness (gorilla, clown, radiologists, driving)
b04: change blindness (door, flicker, film, eyewitnesses)
b05: rubber hand, full-body illusion, phantom limbs, mirror box
b06: McGurk, sine-wave speech, Yanny/Laurel, cocktail party
b07: Muller-Lyer across cultures, WEIRD samples, holistic attention, reading
b08: predictive brain, Mooney images, hollow mask, hallucination priors
b09: wine colour, price labels, placebo, nocebo, open-label placebo
b10: time perception (fall, oddball, ageing, recalibration)
b11: pareidolia, face processing, Mars face, apophenia, pigeon superstition
b12: evolution of perception, umwelt, takeaways, end
